facility.name: Friendship Ranch Child Development Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1108 24TH ST, CANYON, TX, 79015

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: One playground and several pieces of equipment with bird poop dried on toys and active play equipment that children were observed playing on at inspection. Two play cars have broken plastic that that requires repair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An individual was present at inspection in a classroom without an eligibility notification received from the centralized background check unit. The caregiver was removed from the classroom at inspection and then left the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The younger age group playground has two nails protruding and pieces of the fence with sharp edges. This was corrected at inspection with the nails secured into the fence and a piece of cardboard taped over the sharp edges. The older age group playground has two broken fence posts with sharp edges. This was corrected at inspection with cardboard taped over the broken pieces. The school age classroom has a plastic drawer that is cracked and has a sharp edge. The pre k classroom has a counter top is torn up and requires replacement. The toddler classroom has toys that are broken or dirty. The broken toys were removed and discarded from the classroom at inspection. The toys requiring cleaning were removed from the classroom to be cleaned.  One shelf has broken wooden pieces that require repair. Two chairs have exposed foam and requires repair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: Multiple diaper changes were observed with the diaper changing surface and the surface was not sanitized after each use. A liner was not observed being used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Mutiple children were observed having their diapers changed and they did not have their hands washed afterwards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver was completing diaper changes and did not wash their hands after any of the diaper changes observed by child care regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director lacked training in the following health and safety topics including: handling and storing and disposing of hazardous materials, preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction and  administering medication, Additionally, training is also needed for abuse and neglect training and training related to infants and safe sleep practices.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Multiple areas of the older children playground has deep holes that present a trip hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: Two caregivers were not knowledgeable about the number of children they were responsible for and had to count to know the number of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Prek children were playing in the outdoor play area where part of a landscape piece had a large nail facing up. ** The  landscape piece was removed immediately by the director. The infant outdoor play area had bird feces on tables and the play structure. ** The out door infant tables and area was cleaned immediately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: Caregivers in the school age classroom communicating with the children in an abrasive manner and were not communicating in a positive manner.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: A caregiver in the infant room was observed pulling an infant by the arm in an agressive manner.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: The safety alarm was not working in the primary vehicle used for transporting children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Outdoor Activities: A group of children were observed transitioning from the outdoor playground to their classroom for snack. Children did not have their hands washed prior to snack.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Outdoor Activities (26 TAC §746.3417(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: One classroom had a fan on the top of a shelf with the cord stretched across an emergency exit door  that presented a risk if a child was to pull down on the cord and tip the tower fan off the shelf and onto the floor. Additionally, a drawer in the school age classroom was broken with a sharp edge. On the playground, a broken pole protruded from the ground and presents a risk if a child was to fall on it. Additionally, cleaning supplies was observe stored next to children's snacks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director was lacking transportation training in the last completed training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: A magic eraser was observed on the floor accessible to children in the infant/toddler classroom. Additionally, lysol was sitting on the counter space next to the box of pop tarts for breakfast. Additionally, the children's sippy cups were next to another canister of lysol as well. This was corrected at inspection with the magic eraser picked up off the floor and the lysol moved to a bucket just meant for cleaning supplies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: In preparation for lunch time, infants and toddlers were placed at the table and several children were not secured with the safety straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: A classroom with infants and toddlers had infants observed in the multiple occupancy table for 40 minutes during center time for the younger toddlers. Later on in the morning, the infants and toddlers were placed back in the table for an additional 35 minutes prior to the start of lunch time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used: The diaper changing pad for the toddler classroom was observed being used for diaper changes on the play floor space of the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §746.3503(b))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: One caregiver was observed changing diapers and she did not wash her hands or the children's hands after diaper changes. Additionally, she did not wash her hands before handling food to be served and the children did not have their hands washed prior to eating lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: The personnel file for the director was not available at inspection for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Not Used as a Passageway: A classroom with a combination of infants or toddlers was observed being used as a passage way for older children. The older children were observed entering the infant classroom from the playground and walking through the classroom to gain access to the hallway that leads to their classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Not Used as a Passageway (26 TAC §746.2403(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Several activities occurred in the classroom that the caregiver did not have awareness of due to her divided focus of other duties. One child was in the bathroom connected to the classroom and an infant went into the bathroom without the caregiver realizing until she went to check on the older child using the toilet. While assisting the child in the bathroom, children were hitting each other at the table and the caregiver lacked auditory and visual awareness of the infant at the table. In a different classroom, three caregivers were present but did not awareness that children were running around while eating food and did not attempt to redirect the child to the table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: Children were served food without a napkin or plate to prevent the food from being placed on the table for morning snack.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The outdoor space has various hazards including exposed nails on the fencing, missing or broken fence posts and the bottom portion of the fencing exposed outwards with sharp edges. The gate to the outdoor fence is broken and unable to stay full enclosed where the gates meet to latch.  Inside the operation, the infant classroom table has a broken off exposed screw. Two classrooms have trash cans with diapers that does not have a lid to keep it inaccessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Annual Sanitation Inspection: The most recent health inspection form was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3403)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: A fire drill was not documented for October, November and December of 2022. For the calendar 2022 year, only two severe weather/sheltering drills occurred out of four and one lock down drill out of four. Additionally, the fire extinguisher check, smoke detector check and carbon monoxide detector check was not documented for October, November and December 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Three classrooms that utilize cots do not have them labeled with the child's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Outdoor Play Daily: Based on interviews with staff, the infants are going outside 1-2 times a week and are not having morning and afternoon opportunities daily to be outside. Additionally, the written activity plan does not include two daily opportunities in their written activity plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Outdoor Play Daily (26 TAC §746.2417(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The toddler playground had various fence posts that were not secured that were a pinch hazard with exposed nails. One fence post was on the ground with a nail sticking out. The fence post was picked up from the ground at inspection. All protruding fence posts that were pinch hazards were secured back to the fence line. All hazards were corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies was lacking a policy of promotion of outdoor play to include duration of active play, clothing and footwear recommendation and alternate plan when weather prevents outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: Various snack choices did meet the USDA guidelines of nutrition and did not meet two food groups.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))
